text:
Integrated application lifecycle

Because specific platform components are not identified, this is a capability-level model. In this model, the platform should maintain one versioned application record linking purpose, ownership, requirements, decisions, risks, designs, code, tests, approvals, deployments, telemetry, incidents, costs, and feedback. Automation performs repeatable checks and delivery tasks, while accountable people make risk-appropriate decisions. Production evidence then updates the backlog, closing the loop.

Diagram
flowchart TD
    A[User submits idea and desired outcome] --> B[Platform captures purpose users ownership and success measures]
    B --> C[Discovery clarifies scope requirements constraints and acceptance criteria]
    C --> D[Classify complexity criticality security and compliance risk]
    D --> E{Initiative approved}
    E -- No --> F[Reject defer or preserve for later review]
    E -- Yes --> G[Fund prioritize and create governed backlog]
    G --> H[Design experience architecture data integrations and controls]
    H --> I{Design and residual risk accepted}
    I -- No --> G
    I -- Yes --> J[Provision environments repositories access and delivery pipeline]
    J --> K[Build configuration code data changes and integrations]
    K --> L[Automated review build test and security checks]
    L --> M{Quality gates passed}
    M -- No --> K
    M -- Yes --> N[Integration performance accessibility recovery and user testing]
    N --> O{Acceptance and release readiness approved}
    O -- No --> G
    O -- Yes --> P[Package version migration rollback monitoring and support plans]
    P --> Q[Deploy progressively to production]
    Q --> R[Validate health data integrity and critical user journeys]
    R --> S{Release healthy}
    S -- No --> T[Rollback contain incident and remediate]
    T --> K
    S -- Yes --> U[Operate monitor secure support backup and recover]
    U --> V[Measure usage reliability cost risk and business outcomes]
    V --> W[Combine telemetry incidents feedback and strategic changes]
    W --> X[Prioritize enhancements fixes and technical debt]
    X --> G
    U --> Y{Retirement appropriate}
    Y -- Yes --> Z[Migrate or archive data remove access and close service]
    Y -- No --> V
limitations: The platform’s named products, components, roles, and exact automation capabilities were not supplied, so the explanation is conceptual rather than product-specific.
